snippet.title: Blasphemous: Strife and Ruin - Announcement Trailer | PS4
snippet.description:
Miriam has appeared in Cvstodia in the Blasphemous: Strife and Ruin update. Another free DLC, coming February 18th!

Help Miriam return to her world by collecting shards and tackling expert, platforming challenge rooms that will test the most advanced players. This update also includes: 
•        Boss Rush Mode – take on former foes to achieve the best rank
•        New Render Modes – added retro gameplay filters for that added hit of nostalgia
•        New prayers and secrets

Follow The Game Kitchen on Twitter: https://twitter.com/thegamekitchen?lang=en
Follow Blasphemous on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/blasphemousgame/
Follow Team17 on Twitter: https://twitter.com/Team17Ltd
Like Team17 on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Team17/

About Team17 Group plc Founded in 1990, Team17 Group plc is a leading international video games label and creative partner for independent developers. The portfolio comprises over 100 games, including The Escapists, Overcooked, Yoku’s Island Express, Yooka-Laylee, the Worms franchise and many more from developers around the world. Visit www.team17.com for more info
